ai_language_tip: Speak clear, polite standard Czech (cs); Slovak callers are understood; English works in Prague centre, Brno, hotels and with younger staff, far less at GP surgeries, offices and village trades.
english_ok: sometimes — Good in Prague tourist areas, hotels and international firms; patchy at GP practices, municipal offices and outside big cities.
politeness: Formal 'vykání' (vy) with strangers, 'pane/paní' + surname; open with 'Dobrý den' and say for whom you call; close with 'Děkuji, na shledanou'.
name_tip: Surname first; female surnames add -ová (Novák / Nováková), so give the exact form; foreign names are spelled letter by letter and may be declined in speech.
phone_tip: All numbers are 9 digits with no trunk 0 (mobile 123 456 789, Prague landline 2xx xxx xxx), +420 country code; SMS confirmation common.
time_tip: TRAP: 'půl osmé' = 7:30, 'čtvrt na osm' = 7:15, 'tři čtvrtě na osm' = 7:45; always read back in 24h ('devatenáct třicet').
number_tip: Numbers decline with nouns ('dvě osoby', 'pět osob'); 2+kk / 3+1 describe flat layouts, not party size; read phones in groups of three.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch rush 11:30–13:30 (polední menu), dinner peak 18:30–20:30, calls after 20:00 and weekends for offices; surgeries often take calls only in the morning before the patients.
closed_days: Shops open on Sundays, but larger shops must close on several public holidays (e.g. 1 January, Easter Monday, 8 May, 28 September, 28 October, 25–26 December); surgeries close weekends and many restaurants close Sunday evening or Monday.
booking_channels: Reservio, Bookio and Reenio pages for salons, sports and classes; Doktor.cz links and clinic systems for doctors; Google and phone for restaurants; Foodora, Wolt and Bolt Food for delivery; phone still dominant for trades and garages.
voice_menu: Operators (O2, T-Mobile, Vodafone), banks, Česká pošta, Zásilkovna and insurers use keypad IVR; small venues answer directly on a mobile.
callback_habits: Booking systems send email/SMS confirmation and a reminder a day or a few hours before; small businesses call back or SMS from a mobile.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 保齡球（bowling）、壁球、運動場地多用 Reenio 或電話預約；熱門城堡與景點走官網購時段票。

may_come_up.what: Castle guided tours (prohlídka) sold in timed slots online

sensitive_asked.what: Asks prepayment to a private účet for a group lane

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 捷克髮廊、美甲多用 Reservio 或 Bookio 線上預約，但老店仍以電話為主。

may_come_up.what: Reservio no-show blocking or late-cancel fee

sensitive_asked.what: Asks záloha by bank transfer before a balayage

usually_asked: Name and mobile for the SMS reminder

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期取消宜提早；Reservio、Bookio 預約可用簡訊連結改期，私人牙醫可能收取消費。

may_come_up.what: Private dentist charges for a missed appointment (storno poplatek)

sensitive_asked.what: Practice asks rodné číslo to locate the appointment

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 家庭醫師（praktický lékař）多只在早上接電話，看專科常需 žádanka；必問所屬健保公司（VZP、ZPMV、OZP 等），新病人常被拒收。

may_come_up.what: Nurse offers a slot via the practice's Reservio or UPMed page
Practice has stopped registering new patients (nepřijímáme nové pacienty)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks rodné číslo, which doubles as the insurance number

usually_asked: Reason and whether a žádanka exists

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、能源客服有語音選單並依 GDPR 核身，代打難以處理帳戶事項。

may_come_up.what: O2 or ČEZ line refuses a third party without plná moc

sensitive_asked.what: Asks rodné číslo, PIN or SMS codes

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政辦事可經 Portál občana 線上或預約臨櫃；小學報名（zápis）在四月，電話可問流程。

may_come_up.what: Úřad slots booked through an online objednávkový systém

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 公寓需給街道、門牌（č. p.）、樓層與門鈴名（zvonek）；水電（instalatér）與鎖匠常以時段約，急件夜間加價。

may_come_up.what: Výjezd (callout) fee plus hourly rate
Night or weekend locksmith surcharge

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 民宿（penzion）與山區小屋常電話或 Email 訂房並收 záloha；入住需登記，地方收住宿費（poplatek z pobytu）。

may_come_up.what: Poplatek z pobytu charged per person per night
Záloha transfer within days to confirm a penzion

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport or ID number for the guest book

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 營業時間、可否刷卡、是否有貨、可否帶狗等通常直接回答；捷克多數餐廳允許帶狗。

may_come_up.what: Kitchen stops cooking before the pub (hospoda) closes

usually_asked: The question (otevírací doba, platba kartou, pes)

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（veterinář）與寵物美容可電話預約；出境需歐盟寵物護照與晶片。

may_come_up.what: Pohotovost (emergency) fee outside hours

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多經 Sreality、Bezrealitky 與房仲（RK），電話約看房；押金（kauce）通常一至三個月租金。

may_come_up.what: Agent asks the Sreality listing number

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽車服務廠（autoservis）、春秋換胎（přezutí）與車檢 STK 多電話或線上預約；STK 站常需提前數週。

may_come_up.what: Diagnostics charged if repair is declined (diagnostika)
STK station books the emission test (emise) first

sensitive_asked.what: Asks VIN from the malý technický průkaz

usually_asked: Work: servis, přezutí, STK or emise

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 捷克餐廳多接電話訂位，也有官網或 Google 訂位；平日中午有 polední menu 多不必訂，週末晚上與聖誕公司聚餐（firemní večírek）季要提早。

may_come_up.what: Lunch menu (polední menu) served without booking until about 14:00
Záloha required for Christmas company parties

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number to hold a Prague Old Town table

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 藥局（lékárna）、麵包店與甜點店（cukrárna）可電話預訂；聖誕餅乾（cukroví）與蛋糕要提早。

may_come_up.what: Lékárna can reserve a non-prescription item for later pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Asks prepayment for a cukrárna celebration cake

usually_asked: Cake size or weight in kg

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩店與越南、中式小館常接電話外帶（s sebou）；外送多走 Foodora、Wolt、Bolt Food。

may_come_up.what: Delivery only through Foodora or Wolt
Extra charge for takeaway packaging (obal)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number by phone before cooking

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Zásilkovna、PPL、DPD、Česká pošta 追蹤以網站 App 為主；Zásilkovna 取件用 SMS 碼。

may_come_up.what: Zásilkovna hotline points to its tracking page

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the Zásilkovna pickup code from SMS

transport.before_dialing_zh: 布拉格以 Liftago、Bolt、Uber 為主，地方城市仍有電話叫車車行；機場接送可預約。

may_come_up.what: Liftago-style dispatch confirms plate and ETA
Fixed price to Václav Havel Airport

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks card or řidičský průkaz number
